Zara (CS): Heads-up: Kalahari Connect needs a short promo setup into af-south-1. Requirements: new region peering, partner CIDR allowlist, SAML SSO enable, and a temporary QPS bump for two weeks. They also flagged a future Private deploy with HSM/KMS needs and want residency proof for renewal.

Thabo (Kalahari Connect): Yep. Promo window 2025-06-01 -> 2025-06-15, business hours 06:00-20:00 SAST. Baseline QPS ~180, want to burst to 700 for /v1/generate. CIDRs: 197.232.10.0/24 and 197.232.10.128/32. Egress ~210Mbps.

Rashmi (NetOps): Paste any specific service routes and confirm whether mutual TLS is needed. We can request peering to af-south-1 but need to reserve a PoP. Auto-revoke for allowlist OK?

Thabo (Kalahari Connect): Mainly /v1/generate; small personalization embedding calls (~100 concurrent). No client certs for initial run. Auto-revoke required.

Evan (Solutions Eng): Proposed plan: 1) ephemeral allowlist with auto-revoke on 2025-06-16; 2) apply temp policy "kalahari-promo-700" scoped to af-south-1 and /v1/generate; 3) schedule 30m SAML metadata exchange + test; 4) open Private deploy discovery ticket for HSM/KMS checklist.

Priya (AE): Renewal risk noted  they need a region-specific storage log bundle and a short HSM isolation statement. I'll own the renewal artifact and pull Security.

Zara (CS): I'll schedule the SAML call tomorrow 09:30 SAST and draft a compact runbook. Thabo, please confirm exact timestamps for the promo hours and if webhooks need special handling.

Thabo (Kalahari Connect): Confirmed hours 06:00-20:00 SAST, webhooks remain at normal limits. Please ensure embeddings cap at 100 concurrent.

edge-bot: Created ticket CS-10021. Peering PoP reservation ETA 24h. Promo profile applied to staging. Auto-revoke timer scheduled.

Rashmi (NetOps): Provision checklist in CS-10021: - Open peering request for af-south-1 and reserve PoP - Apply allowlist: 197.232.10.0/24, 197.232.10.128/32 (auto-revoke 2025-06-16T00:00:00Z) - Apply policy kalahari-promo-700 active 06:00-20:00 SAST, tag routes kalahari-promo - Monitoring: alert at 75% -> notify @Zara; audit logging enabled.

Evan (Solutions Eng): I'll attach a short SAML test matrix (ACS URL, SP EntityID, attribute map) to CS-10021 and include Console steps.

Priya (AE): I'll draft the renewal doc and coordinate with Security for HSM wording. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Zara (CS): Recap: CS-10021 covers peering, ephemeral allowlist, promo profile, SAML call tomorrow 09:30 SAST, renewal doc owned by Priya. Ping here for changes.

Thabo (Kalahari Connect): Thanks all, appreciate the temporary setup and auto-revoke.

(END)
